inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I was tracing the deployment path from the training environment to the production cluster. The model artifact moves directly from the training pipeline to the live inference endpoint. There is no intermediate check or review point where the model output is tested against predefined success metrics before it goes live. The transition happens in a single, uninterrupted step. I see no logs indicating that any human or automated system evaluated the model performance during this specific interval. The data flows from the training job directly into the serving container without pausing for quality assurance. This is the exact sequence of events I witnessed during my audit of the last three deployment cycles.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the observed deployment sequence and the absence of quality assurance steps during an audit, without expressing a wish, refusal, or stated need.
